**Publisher key(s)** (Ed25519 public key, PEM / SubjectPublicKeyInfo):

```
key id:
-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----
…
```

**Contact** (email or org URL):

**Declarations** (all required — replace [ ] with [x]):

- [ ] I hold the private half of the key(s) above.
- [ ] The name follows the rules in GOVERNANCE.md (3-63 chars, `[a-z][a-z0-9-]`,
